about-simple-dynamic.headline: About IBS Academy
about-simple-dynamic.topIntro: A premier ISO 9001:2015 certified institute with over two decades of excellence in professional accounting education.
about-simple-dynamic.label: Our Story of Success
about-simple-dynamic.subIntro: For over 20 years, we have been bridging the skill gap in the industry by providing direct certifications from global leaders.
about-simple-dynamic.mainStatement: As INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS SOLUTIONS, our mission is to empower the next generation of accounting professionals. We address the industry's critical shortage of skilled talent by delivering state-of-the-art training in accounting, inventory, and taxation. Our industry-relevant syllabus and partnerships with software giants like SAP and Tally ensure our students are career-ready. Our story is one of success, built on serving over 5000 clients and a steadfast commitment to academic excellence.
